title: 阿利斯塔·小花盆
description: 紫色牛头阿利斯塔小心捧着花盆，弯腰看一朵小黄花，粗壮体形与花形成可爱对比。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Alistar is a large purple minotaur with broad cream horns, a heavy bovine muzzle, pointed ears, a short dark mane, and huge rounded hands and hooves. Keep his muscular silhouette recognizable but softly simplified, with kind eyes and no threatening teeth. Dress his torso in a plain sturdy sleeveless work vest over an opaque shirt, with a belted cloth wrap.
art_direction.scene: He bends gently beside a garden bench, holding a tiny terracotta flowerpot between both oversized hands as he admires one yellow blossom. A small watering can waits on the ground, well clear of his hooves. Let the horns and shoulders fit fully inside the square, with a simple fence and generous warm paper margins.
art_direction.palette: lavender purple, butter yellow, terracotta, pale sage
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
